name: GamesBeat reprint of the LG and Furiosa RNGD EXAONE numbers
notes: Secondary reprint of the Furiosa and LG announcement. Confirms the same sentence: four RNGD cards, batch size one, EXAONE 3.5 32B, 60 tok/s at 4K context and 50 tok/s at 32K context. Also states 512 TFLOPS FP8, 180 W TDP, an eight-card 4U air-cooled RNGD server, and a vLLM-compatible Furiosa-LLM stack. Not an independent measurement.
